guarantees.claim: cmd_error_o is always the logical OR of one_hot_err_q and cmd_consty_err_q.
prng_en_o is asserted exactly when kmac_data_o.valid and kmac_data_i.ready are both high.

assumptions.claim: Whenever valid is asserted (the module is transmitting), the strobe signal strb must not be zero.
assumptions.risk: If violated, strb == 0 indicates no valid bytes, which could corrupt KMAC data input, potentially leading to a wrong digest or security bypass.

uncertain_points.claim: The signal 'valid' used in the assertion is not defined in this chunk; it may be identical to kmac_data_o.valid or a different internal/input signal. Its origin determines whether the assertion is an input assumption or an internal consistency check.
uncertain_points.cond: when the strobe requirement is relevant
uncertain_points.risk: If 'valid' is unrelated to actual transaction valid, the assertion may either over-constrain inputs (needlessly) or miss a genuine hazard where kmac_data_o.valid is high and strb is zero.
